_meta.description: 20 synthetic resumes authored for the HiReady evaluation. No real person's data is used. Four role families x five experience/quality profiles. Each item carries the target role and experience level that the analyser is asked to score against, so that scoring is conditioned identically across repeated runs.
_meta.license: CC BY 4.0 - free to redistribute with the paper's artifact package
